links.comparator_used: Non-prompted queries with no professional role assigned, across four LLMs (GPT-5, GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3, Gemini 2.5 Flash)
links.outcome: Guideline-concordance accuracy and error direction (false-positive and false-negative rates) on 26 vital pulp therapy yes/no questions
links.effect: No overall prompt effect with numbers is given in the text. The model × prompt interaction showed a trend toward significance but did not reach the conventional threshold. Gemini had the highest observed accuracy non-prompted and DeepSeek the highest prompted. DeepSeek outperformed GPT-5 and GPT-4o under prompted conditions. Effects varied by model: DeepSeek had reduced false positives and no false negatives when prompted, while Gemini's false negatives increased.
links.tradeoff: Role prompting raised Gemini's false-negative responses, a new error pattern.
links.quote: Error-direction analysis revealed model-specific patterns: Gemini showed consistently low false-positive rates but increased false-negative responses under prompted conditions; DeepSeek showed reduced false-positive and no false-negative responses under prompted conditions.
